_source.title: 获取当前文档的属性
_source.remarks.text.0: 将会获取当前打开且拥有最后输入焦点的文档的文档类型、UUID、所属工程的 UUID 或所属库的 UUID
_source.returns: 文档类型、UUID、所属工程的 UUID、所属库的 UUID 组成的对象，如若为 `undefined` 则获取失败

title: Get the properties of the current document
remarks.text.0: It will get the document type, UUID, and the UUID of the project or library it belongs to for the currently open document that has the last input focus
returns: An object composed of the document type, UUID, the UUID of the project it belongs to, and the UUID of the library it belongs to. If it is `undefined`, the retrieval failed
